Home Inventory Manager — application workflow
Static screen mockups in flow order (matches docs/DESIGN.md). Notes describe what each step does.

AUTHENTICATION
1 · Register — submits email + password. Creates the user (unverified) and their 5 default categories in one transaction, then emails a verification link. Rate limited.
2 · Verify Email — reached by opening the emailed link. A valid token sets emailVerified. Invalid or expired shows a resend option instead.
3 · Login — refused with "please verify your email" until step 2 is done. Success opens a database session. Rate limited.
Branch · Forgot Password — always shows the same confirmation message, whether or not the email is registered. Rate limited.
Branch · Reset Password — reached from the reset email. Success updates the password, invalidates existing sessions, and returns to Login.

CORE APPLICATION
4 · Dashboard — entry point after login. Category counts plus a warranty banner, shown only when the Settings toggle is on. Try expanding the banner below.
5 · Item List — reached from a category card or the warranty banner. Filter by category, search, or jump to expiring items.
6 · Item Detail — the full record: fields, photos, receipt, and warranty document.
7 · Item Create / Edit — one shared form for both. Photos, receipt, and warranty doc are captured by camera or gallery and upload directly to Blob storage.
Dashboard → Categories — add, rename, or delete. New accounts start with the 5 defaults shown here.
Dashboard → Settings — change password, and toggle the warranty banner. The toggle below actually works.

RESPONSIVE — ≥640px viewports
Same screens, wider viewport. Per docs/DESIGN.md, content stays in a centered 640px column rather than stretching full-width — only the grids inside it gain columns (3 category cards instead of 2, 2-up item cards, photos beside fields on Item Detail). Forms and lists never sprawl edge-to-edge on a large monitor.
Item List at ≥640px: the same search/filter bar, item cards reflow from a single column into two.
Item Detail at ≥640px: photos + documents move beside the field list instead of stacking above it.
